response.text: {"label": "misread_spec", "reason": "The target needs a rejected false start bit while 3C is stalled with tready low, but the sub sends 3C cleanly, sits idle for 40 cycles (sub `383 ... rx busy_fall 0` then `438 ... rx hs 3c` with no rx activity between), then sends A5 and waits for tvalid to fall with tready held low, so `rx hs a5` never happens (gold `158 ... rx hs a5`) and the run times out."}
